tools.name: meal_plan_get
tools.summary: Shows the meal plan for a date range, including planned calories per day and unscheduled meals.

tools.name: meal_plan_add
tools.summary: Schedules a recipe as a meal.

tools.name: meal_plan_remove
tools.summary: Removes one or more meals from the meal plan (IDs from meal_plan_get).

tools.name: meal_plan_move
tools.summary: Moves a scheduled meal to a different date or slot.

tools.name: meal_plan_clear
tools.summary: Clears a date range of the meal plan.

tools.name: meal_plan_previously_planned
tools.summary: Shows meals that have been on the plan before - a pool for a new week without having to search again.

tools.name: meal_plan_note_add
tools.summary: Adds a free-text note to a day of the meal plan.

tools.name: meal_plan_note_update
tools.summary: Replaces date and text of an existing note.

tools.name: meal_plan_note_delete
tools.summary: Deletes a meal plan note.

tools.name: meal_plan_note_undelete
tools.summary: Restores a note deleted with meal_plan_note_delete (use the noteId you deleted).

tools.name: meal_plan_meal_update
tools.summary: Updates the content entry of a planned meal.

tools.name: meal_plan_settings_get
tools.summary: Shows the settings of the meal plan: first day of the week and sharing mode (private or public) with the number of collaborators.

tools.name: meal_plan_settings_update
tools.summary: Sets the first day of the week of the meal plan (the only meal plan setting the API has).

tools.name: meal_plan_share_link
tools.summary: Generates an invite link for the meal plan and returns it.

tools.name: meal_plan_templates
tools.summary: Lists your own weekly templates.

tools.name: meal_plan_save_template
tools.summary: Saves a date range of the meal plan as a weekly template so it can be applied to any week later.

tools.name: meal_plan_apply_template
tools.summary: Applies a weekly template to the meal plan from a start date.

tools.name: meal_plan_delete_template
tools.summary: Deletes your own weekly templates.

tools.name: meal_plan_template_list
tools.summary: Lists the curated public meal plan templates from Samsung Food (not your own - those are in meal_plan_templates).

tools.name: meal_plan_template_update
tools.summary: Renames or re-describes one of your own templates (id from meal_plan_templates or meal_plan_save_template).

tools.name: shopping_list_get
tools.summary: Shows the shopping list with open and completed items, grouped by category.

tools.name: shopping_list_add
tools.summary: Adds free-text items to the shopping list, e.g.

tools.name: shopping_list_add_recipe
tools.summary: Copies all ingredients of a recipe to the shopping list and merges quantities.

tools.name: shopping_list_update
tools.summary: Checks items off, undoes that, or deletes them (IDs from shopping_list_get).

tools.name: shopping_lists
tools.summary: Lists all shopping lists of the account, including shared lists.

tools.name: shopping_list_create
tools.summary: Creates a new (non-primary) shopping list, optionally filled with free-text items like "2 onions".

tools.name: shopping_list_rename
tools.summary: Renames a shopping list.

tools.name: shopping_list_delete
tools.summary: Deletes a shopping list with all its items; this cannot be undone and affects everyone the list is shared with.

tools.name: shopping_list_copy
tools.summary: Copies a shopping list including its items into a new list (named "Copy of <name>", localized by the server).

tools.name: shopping_list_set_primary
tools.summary: Makes a shopping list the primary one.

tools.name: shopping_list_recent_items
tools.summary: Items recently used on any shopping list (the suggestion pool of the app).

tools.name: shopping_list_favorites
tools.summary: Favorite shopping items (quick-add pool).

tools.name: shopping_list_favorites_modify
tools.summary: Creates, updates or deletes favorite shopping items in one call.

tools.name: shopping_list_share_link
tools.summary: Generates a share link for a shopping list and returns it.

tools.name: recipe_search
tools.summary: Searches your own saved recipes across all collections.

tools.name: recipe_discover
tools.summary: Returns recipe suggestions from the global catalog for browsing.

tools.name: recipe_get
tools.summary: Fetches a recipe with ingredients, instructions and nutrition.

tools.name: recipe_similar
tools.summary: Finds recipes similar to a given recipe.

tools.name: recipe_import_url
tools.summary: Extracts a recipe from any website and saves it to the account.

tools.name: recipe_create
tools.summary: Creates a custom recipe.

tools.name: recipe_delete
tools.summary: Deletes a custom recipe.

tools.name: recipe_update
tools.summary: Changes fields of one of YOUR OWN recipes (created with recipe_create or imported); everything not passed stays as it is.

tools.name: recipe_rate
tools.summary: Likes or dislikes a recipe (Samsung Food has a thumbs up/down, no stars).

tools.name: recipe_review_post
tools.summary: Posts your written review of a recipe with optional tags and a like/dislike.

tools.name: recipe_review_get
tools.summary: Shows a review.

tools.name: recipe_review_delete
tools.summary: Deletes YOUR review/rating of a recipe (only your own can be deleted).

tools.name: recipe_autocomplete
tools.summary: Suggests search terms for a prefix, as the search box of the app does.

tools.name: recipe_categories
tools.summary: Lists the search categories of the explore page (id, title, image), e.g.

tools.name: recipe_smart_collection
tools.summary: Smart collections are the automatic recipe lists of the app: made_it, recently_viewed, planned and my_recipes.

tools.name: recipe_recommended
tools.summary: The personalized recommendation feed of the home screen, recipes only (id, name, image, who posted it).

tools.name: recipe_health_recommend
tools.summary: Meal suggestions per day and meal slot that fit the calorie and nutrition goals of the account (see account_info), with the reasons (caloriesMacros, dqsAhei, foodList, mlRerank and their weight).

tools.name: recipe_health_alternatives
tools.summary: More health-based suggestions for ONE meal slot of one day (the "show other options" of the recommendations).

tools.name: recipe_dish_lookup
tools.summary: Dish pages: generic dishes (burger, bread, ...) with typical nutrition per 100 g.

tools.name: recipe_more_from_user
tools.summary: Other recipes by the same author as a given recipe.

tools.name: recipe_recent_queries
tools.summary: Your recent recipe searches, newest first.

tools.name: recipe_recent_query_delete
tools.summary: Removes one entry from your recent recipe searches (query = the exact text from recipe_recent_queries).

tools.name: collections_list
tools.summary: Lists the recipe collections of the account.

tools.name: collection_recipes
tools.summary: Shows the recipes in a collection.

tools.name: collection_get
tools.summary: Details of one recipe collection: name, recipe count, accessMode (private | public) and your role (owner | none).

tools.name: collection_create
tools.summary: Creates an empty recipe collection.

tools.name: collection_update
tools.summary: Renames a collection and/or switches it between private and public.

tools.name: collection_delete
tools.summary: Deletes a recipe collection.

tools.name: collection_copy
tools.summary: Copies a collection into a new one (the server names the copy).

tools.name: collection_add_recipes
tools.summary: Adds recipes to a collection (a recipe can be in several collections).

tools.name: collection_remove_recipes
tools.summary: Removes recipes from a collection.

tools.name: collection_share_link
tools.summary: Generates a share link for a recipe collection and returns it.

tools.name: pantry_get
tools.summary: Shows the pantry with storage location, expiry date and daysLeft (negative = expired).

tools.name: pantry_add
tools.summary: Adds entries to the pantry.

tools.name: pantry_update
tools.summary: Changes the expiry date, name or storage location of a pantry entry.

tools.name: pantry_consume
tools.summary: Marks pantry entries as consumed, undoes that, or deletes them entirely.

tools.name: food_storage_info
tools.summary: Looks up where an ingredient is stored and how long it keeps there - without creating anything.

tools.name: food_search
tools.summary: Searches the food graph (generic foods and ingredients, not recipes).

tools.name: food_get
tools.summary: Shows one food: its portion sizes (name such as "medium"/"large", grams) and the nutrition per 100 g (Edamam codes like ENERC_KCAL, FAT, CHOCDF, PROCNT).

tools.name: food_autocomplete
tools.summary: Suggests food names for a prefix (e.g.

tools.name: food_product_search
tools.summary: Searches the Foodpedia product encyclopedia (ingredients incl.

tools.name: food_product_get
tools.summary: Shows a Foodpedia product: category, description, storage location, glycemic index, nutrition per 100 g, grams per unit (piece, slice, ...), suitable diets, tips, substitutes and a few linked recipes.

tools.name: food_product_popular
tools.summary: Lists popular Foodpedia products (turmeric, ...).

tools.name: nutrition_analyze
tools.summary: Parses free-text ingredient lines such as "2 cups milk" or "400 g hokkaido pumpkin" into the normalized food (canonical name), category, quantity and unit.

tools.name: foodlog_add_from_meal_plan
tools.summary: Logs planned meals as eaten in the food log (so they count towards your nutrition tracking).

tools.name: foodlog_delete
tools.summary: Removes entries from the food log (the meal stays in the meal plan).

tools.name: account_info
tools.summary: Shows your own account with nutrition goals and settings.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.summary: Shows whether a Samsung Food login is stored, when it expires and when it was last renewed.

tools.name: auth_login
tools.summary: Logs in with a browser session: validates the value, renews it to learn the expiry and stores it.

tools.name: account_settings_get
tools.summary: Shows the preferences of the account in a readable form: diets, avoidances, cuisines, cooking level, household, units, body data, nutrition goals, meal planning preferences and notification switches.

tools.name: account_settings_update
tools.summary: Changes preferences of the account.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.summary: Shows how many uses are left of a limited feature: mealplan_template_collections (curated meal plan templates) or hr_tailored_plan (tailored plan).

tools.name: api_methods
tools.summary: Lists the available gRPC methods of the Samsung Food API, optionally filtered by substring.

tools.name: api_describe
tools.summary: Shows the request and response fields of a gRPC method so that api_call can be used correctly.

tools.name: api_call
tools.summary: Calls any gRPC method directly.
